answer: Divergent-Challenge Credentialing. Each identity must periodically answer a freshly generated challenge whose seed derives from a private vault of unpredictable data. Honest agents produce divergent answers; clones sharing one origin cannot, since identical inputs force identical outputs. A fable of unique lineage is thus testable, not trusted. Any island of clones collapses to one answer, exposing duplicates. Attacker cost: one independent entropy source and challenge-response run per identity, making N sybils cost N real divergences.
